# Times Higher Education

> > Authoritative global university rankings and performance analysis across academic disciplines and research excellence.

Times Higher Education (THE) publishes the World University Rankings, providing comprehensive subject-specific rankings across engineering, life sciences, physical sciences, social sciences, arts and humanities, and clinical health. Rankings utilize detailed performance indicators and research metrics to evaluate institutional academic performance globally.

## Key Topics

- World University Rankings
- Subject Rankings
- Higher Education Performance
- Academic Excellence Metrics
- Engineering & Technology
- Life Sciences
- Physical Sciences
- Social Sciences
- Arts & Humanities
- Clinical & Health Rankings
- Research Metrics
- University Performance Indicators
- Global University Comparison
- Teaching Quality Assessment
- Citation Impact Analysis

## Subject Rankings by Discipline

- [World University Rankings by Subject 2015: Arts and Humanities](https://www.timeshighereducation.com/world-university-rankings/2015/arts-and-humanities): 2015 Arts & Humanities subject rankings for top 100 universities
- [World University Rankings by Subject 2013: Engineering](https://www.timeshighereducation.com/world-university-rankings/2013/subject-ranking/engineering-and-IT): 2013 Engineering & Technology subject rankings for top 50 universities
- [World University Rankings by Subject 2013: Life Sciences](https://www.timeshighereducation.com/world-university-rankings/2013/life-sciences/detailed): 2013 Life Sciences subject rankings with detailed performance indicators
- [World University Rankings by Subject 2012: Physical Sciences](https://www.timeshighereducation.com/world-university-rankings/2012/physical-sciences): 2012 Physical Sciences subject rankings for top 50 universities
- [World University Rankings by Subject 2012: Social Sciences](https://www.timeshighereducation.com/world-university-rankings/2012/social-sciences/detailed): 2012 Social Sciences subject rankings with detailed metrics
- [World University Rankings by Subject 2013: Arts and Humanities](https://www.timeshighereducation.com/world-university-rankings/2013/arts-and-humanities): 2013 Arts & Humanities subject rankings for top 50 universities

## Rankings Methodology & Analysis

- [World University Rankings by Subject 2014: Clinical, Pre-clinical & Health Methodology](https://www.timeshighereducation.com/world-university-rankings/2014/clinical-pre-clinical-health/methodology): 2014 Clinical & Health rankings methodology with 13 performance indicators
- [World University Rankings by Subject 2014: Engineering Commentary](https://www.timeshighereducation.com/world-university-rankings/2014/engineering-and-IT/commentary): 2014 Engineering & Technology rankings commentary and analysis
- [World University Rankings by Subject 2013: Social Sciences Commentary](https://www.timeshighereducation.com/world-university-rankings/2013/social-sciences/commentary): 2013 Social Sciences rankings commentary and insights
- [World University Rankings by Subject 2013: Engineering Commentary](https://www.timeshighereducation.com/world-university-rankings/2013/engineering-and-IT/commentary): 2013 Engineering & Technology rankings commentary and analysis
